decision_policy: No candidate is a registry entry until the author records explicit assent and completes the adoption gates.

candidates.title: Human authority over irreversible / self-modifying agent actions
candidates.scope_boundary: Only unattended, self-modifying, irreversible, auto-publishing, or auto-spending agent actions; not ordinary scripted assistance or supervised tooling.

typed_exemption_design.required_evidence_policy: Every adopted exemption must name its conjunction semantics and verified human-control, reversibility, or authorization evidence.

false_positive_controls: Teaching or supervised documentation alone does not block.
Description prose cannot supply an undeclared capability scope.
positive_cases: Declared autonomous_agent plus irreversible_action with missing human-control evidence blocks.
negative_cases: Ordinary scripted assistance with an accountable operator remains outside this candidate.

candidates.title: Honest authorship, credit, and AI-assistance disclosure
candidates.scope_boundary: Attribution, credit, plagiarism, citation, byline, and AI-assistance disclosure in published work; not private drafting or ordinary editing.

typed_exemption_design.required_evidence_policy: Every adopted exemption must name collaborator consent, provenance, and disclosure evidence with explicit any/all semantics.

false_positive_controls: Private drafting without a publication claim is outside this candidate.
A title or description cannot launder an undeclared authorship scope.
positive_cases: Declared plagiarism or ai_disclosure in a release context without provenance blocks.
negative_cases: Ordinary editing with no publication or attribution claim does not block.

candidates.title: Consent / review / withdrawal for research on persons
candidates.scope_boundary: Enrollment, intervention, identifiable participant data, withdrawal, and review of research on persons; not anonymous aggregate or non-human work.

typed_exemption_design.required_evidence_policy: Every adopted exemption must name consent, review, withdrawal, and data-provenance evidence with explicit any/all semantics.

false_positive_controls: Aggregate research without individualized output stays outside this candidate.
Free-text claims cannot substitute for verified consent or review evidence.
positive_cases: Declared human_subjects plus participant_intervention without verified consent or review blocks.
negative_cases: Anonymous aggregate analysis without individualized intervention does not block.

candidates.title: No repurposing of student data or the teaching relationship
candidates.scope_boundary: Student records, grades, coursework reuse, profiling, and carceral education relationships; not public teaching materials or de-identified pedagogy.

typed_exemption_design.required_evidence_policy: Every adopted exemption must name student consent, role authority, purpose limitation, and retention or flow-down evidence with explicit any/all semantics.

false_positive_controls: Description-only mentions are advisory and cannot substitute for declared student-data scope.
positive_cases: Declared student_records plus coursework_reuse without verified authority and consent blocks.
negative_cases: Public teaching materials or de-identified pedagogy without student records remain outside this candidate.

candidates.title: AII treasurer stewardship boundary
candidates.scope_boundary: Treasurer stewardship, commingling, self-dealing, conflicts, private inurement, and financial misrepresentation; not ordinary software work.

typed_exemption_design.required_evidence_policy: Every adopted exemption must name charter authority, conflict disclosure, approvals, and transaction evidence with explicit any/all semantics.

false_positive_controls: Routine bookkeeping without declared fiduciary scope does not block.
This candidate cannot be activated by prose alone and requires separate charter confirmation.
positive_cases: Declared self_dealing plus undisclosed_conflict with missing disclosure evidence blocks.
negative_cases: Ordinary software work with no fiduciary scope remains outside this candidate.

candidates.title: Welfare / permits in organismal fieldwork
candidates.scope_boundary: Organism collection, animal research, specimens, permits, and ecological harm; not ordinary simulations or literature review.

typed_exemption_design.required_evidence_policy: Every adopted exemption must name permits, welfare review, minimization, and chain-of-custody evidence with explicit any/all semantics.

false_positive_controls: Ecology or simulation alone does not block.
Narrative cannot substitute for declared scope, permit, or welfare evidence.
positive_cases: Declared animal_research plus collecting_permit without verified welfare or permit evidence blocks.
negative_cases: Ordinary simulation or literature review remains outside this candidate.
